m1.typescript: m1 an over budget conversation becomes a summary and the newest turn

e1.typescript: e1 old tool results are cleared but their calls and flags stay

e2.typescript: e2 the window drops whole turns and never splits a tool call from its result

e3.typescript: e3 a conversation within budget or with nothing older is left alone

e4.typescript: e4 a second compaction folds the earlier summary into the new one

e5.typescript: e5 a citation that does not match its document is reported

e6.typescript: e6 footnotes number each distinct source once in order of appearance

wrong-clear-all.defect: clears every tool result, the newest ones too

wrong-clear-excluded.defect: clears the results of tools that were to be kept

wrong-window-splits-pair.defect: drops single messages, so a tool result can lose its call

wrong-summarise-under-budget.defect: summarises a conversation that already fits

wrong-skips-old-summary.defect: leaves the earlier summary out of what the summariser reads

wrong-cited-end-inclusive.defect: reads the end of a cited span as inclusive

wrong-footnote-duplicates.defect: gives a source that is cited twice a second number
